captions.detailed: An articulated desk lamp featuring a heavy, circular black base, a dual-segment white metal arm, and a cone-shaped black lamp head. The segments of the arm are connected by pivot joints with black tightening knobs, and a decorative coiled white cord runs along the length of the upper arm. The lamp articulates via a rotating base joint, a pivoting lower arm joint, a middle elbow joint, and a multi-axis joint at the lamp head.
captions.instruction: Generate a Python script using CadQuery to model a realistic, articulated desk lamp. The lamp should feature a heavy circular base, a dual-link arm with pivot joints and tightening knobs, a coiled spring-like wire along the arms, and a conical lamp shade, utilizing black and white materials to distinguish the components.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject consisting of multiple linked parts. The base is created using cylindrical primitives, while the swivel joint and arm brackets are formed by combining boxes and cylinders with boolean operations. The arm links are modeled as rectangular extrusions with rounded ends and pivot holes, accompanied by helical sweeps to simulate the coiled wire. The lamp shade is constructed as a hollowed-out cone (or revolved profile), joined to the upper arm via a multi-piece bracket, with all parts connected by revolute articulations.
